name: fig30_renyi_entropy_vs_index
caption: Renyi entropies of four d = 8 states computed from the eigenvalues. S_0 = ln rank, S_1 is the von Neumann entropy (markers), S_2 = -ln Tr rho^2 and S_infinity = -ln lambda_max. The curves are non-increasing in n and flat only for the maximally mixed state, whose spectrum is flat.
